# notedrift

Markdown notes that stay on your machine, with ranked full-text search and lossless
sync through a shared folder. No server, account, or runtime dependency is required.
Python 3.10 or newer is supported.

A notebook is an ordinary folder of UTF-8 `.md` files. Edit them with your favorite
editor, create files outside the tool, or use the CLI. Every command reconciles the
folder so search sees external edits, moves, and deletions. A small identity comment
at the top of each note lets its history survive a rename.

## Start here

Run directly from a checkout:

```sh
python3 -m notedrift init ./notes
python3 -m notedrift --root ./notes new "Summer trip" --body "Book a train." --tag personal
python3 -m notedrift --root ./notes list
python3 -m notedrift --root ./notes search 'train AND tag:personal'
```

Or install the console command:

```sh
python3 -m pip install .
notedrift --help
```

The package has **zero runtime dependencies**. Installing builds it with setuptools;
running `python3 -m notedrift` from the checkout needs only Python's standard library.
